inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: 2 childrens files did not have  Name, address, and telephone number of the child's physician or an emergency-care facility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Water Activity Permission (26 TAC §747.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: 1 infant child in care did not have an admisson record on file at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: Primary caregiver did not have any trainings for training year 8/26/2023-8/26/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Operation had tv playing for a child under 2 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles: Upon arrival a 6 month old infant was seen asleep in a swing with a propped bottle. This was corrected at inspection by having the caregiver remove the bottle and  move the baby to the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §747.2319(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 2 children in care did not have an immunization record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: Operation did not have safety documentation completed for year 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Upon arrival an infant was asleep in a swing. This was corrected at inspection by having the caregiver move the infant to the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §747.2326(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Storage for Individual Belongings: Operation does not have individual storage for the childrens belongings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage for Individual Belongings (26 TAC §747.4305)

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions: Infant in care did not have infant feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions (26 TAC §747.801(2))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation: Operation did not have orientation completed for household members.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation (26 TAC §747.905(2))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: 3 children in care did not have healthstatements on file at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 1 childs file did not have emergency contact information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: Operation did not have parents rights in operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Admission form does not have emergency contact name, phone number or address.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: Provider does not have date of admission on children's admission information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §747.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow: Provider did not have written activity plan. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow (26 TAC §747.2102(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Provider does not have authorization on children's enrollment/ admission form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation: Provider does not have orientation record for home members.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation (26 TAC §747.905(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: Air conditioner in the back yard does not have a safe guard around it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §747.3501(3))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained: Provider does not have sign in and out logs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained (26 TAC §747.635(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Caregiver does not have name or contact information for children's physician or emergency care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: Provider does not have name or phone number of person who can pick up the children for release.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §747.605(7))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: Provider has not completed CPSC form. Form was provided to provider via email.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Provider has a lawn mower, weed eater and ladder accessible to children in the backyard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Proof Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance: The operation did not have liability insurance. The operation did not have the completed form stating the reason for the lack of insurance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Proof Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §747.211(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The operation had the required 3-A-40BC extinguisher, but did not include the tag indicating that it has been serviced.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §747.5107(b))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records: The operation did not have a personnel record for licensing to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records (26 TAC §747.901)
